assumptions: Footnote 5's unqualified direction to confirm and demonstrate has independent operative effect for its stated minimum content.
This reading retains paragraph 14's request condition for any broader demonstration and recognizes the resulting textual tension.

citations.quote: Product Providers should confirm and, upon SFC’s request, demonstrate to the SFC’s satisfaction the management and operational soundness of the tokenisation arrangement, record keeping of ownership and the integrity of the smart contracts5.

5 Product Providers should confirm and demonstrate to the SFC that, at a minimum, they comply with the requirements as set out in paragraphs 10 to 13 above and the smart contracts are not subject to any contract vulnerabilities or security flaws with a high level of confidence.

Product Providers should, upon SFC’s request, obtain third party audit or verification on the management and operational soundness of the tokenisation arrangement, record keeping of ownership and integrity of the smart contracts.
Product Providers should, upon SFC’s request, obtain satisfactory legal opinion to support its application.

node.dfbeb05a271dfdc22f59b8d9.distinction: Unlike the request-conditioned reading, the omission of a request qualification in footnote 5 creates an independently expected minimum demonstration. This is textually possible but weaker because it reduces the work done by paragraph 14's express condition. It supplies no basis for removing the separate request conditions in paragraphs 15 and 16.

facts.meaning: The assessed actor is a Product Provider within the supplied paragraph 14 provision.
facts.name: is_product_provider

facts.meaning: The SFC has made a request applicable to this provider for the demonstration described in paragraph 14; a request solely for another action does not automatically count.
facts.name: sfc_demonstration_requested

questions: Is footnote 5 independently operative or solely explanatory of the main paragraph?
If independently operative, when and in what form must the minimum demonstration be supplied without a request?
Does SFC satisfaction extend to the independently required minimum demonstration?
node.dfbeb05a271dfdc22f59b8d9.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Within the Product Provider scope, true means the condition for the minimum demonstration specified by footnote 5 is satisfied independently of an SFC request. The constant true expresses this proposed unconditional activation, not an invented fact or a finding that demonstration occurred; false does not arise within scope on this reading. Footnote 5 can be read as independently requiring both confirmation and demonstration to the SFC of compliance with paragraphs 10–13 and the high-confidence smart-contract proposition. With no request, that minimum demonstration would remain expected, while paragraph 14 still expressly conditions its broader demonstration on a request. The precise confidence and satisfaction standards remain unresolved. Paragraphs 15 and 16 still require their respective requests for third-party audit or verification and a satisfactory supporting legal opinion; footnote 5 does not expressly expand those provisions.
node.dfbeb05a271dfdc22f59b8d9.subject: Footnote 5 as an independent minimum demonstration requirement

node.dfbeb05a271dfdc22f59b8d9.question: Under footnote 5's proposed independent operative effect, is its minimum demonstration duty activated without an SFC request?
node.dfbeb05a271dfdc22f59b8d9.unit_of_assessment: Activation of the footnote 5 minimum demonstration for one Product Provider and arrangement.
node.dfbeb05a271dfdc22f59b8d9.temporal_basis: At assessment while within scope; timing and form of performance without a request are unspecified.
node.dfbeb05a271dfdc22f59b8d9.true_means: The minimum demonstration of paragraphs 10–13 compliance and the high-confidence smart-contract proposition is expected independently of a request, not proved performed. Broader paragraph 14 demonstration remains request-conditioned on this rival reading; reconciliation and the precise satisfaction and confidence standards remain unresolved. Paragraphs 15–16 require their own requests.
node.dfbeb05a271dfdc22f59b8d9.false_means: False does not arise within Product Provider scope under this interpretation.
